name: Buzi (Ezekiel's father)
title: The Prophet's Father
summary: Buzi was a priest and the father of the prophet Ezekiel. He belonged to the priestly lineage and lived in Jerusalem before the Babylonian conquest. His name is mentioned only once in the Bible, in connection with the introduction of his famous son.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Ezekiel's father
keyEvents.description: Buzi is named by name at the beginning of the book of Ezekiel, where the prophet is introduced as 'Ezekiel, the son of the priest Buzi'. This establishes Ezekiel's priestly heritage.

keyEvents.title: Priestly lineage
keyEvents.description: As a priest, Buzi belonged to an honorable family responsible for temple service in Jerusalem. This background shaped his son Ezekiel's prophetic ministry with its strong focus on temple visions.
